evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The buyer approved paying without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for the 20-inch model; the order is the 24-inch model.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: One unit was ordered and the mandate asks for one.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The total is under the $100.00 limit.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the submitted cart total.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the 24-inch suitcase that was ordered.

verdict.reason: The agent bought the 24-inch suitcase at step 6 although the mandate asked for the 20-inch model, so the order differs from the approved item. The store charged and shipped as ordered, so the store is not responsible, and the buyer did not authorize this order.
